title: Notion Legacy integration token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 49 vs contracted 50. Twin of "Notion Legacy integration token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of notion-token-shape-1-bare: length: 49 vs contracted 50. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
